email.body1:
Hamza, saw PureLogics crossed $38M in revenue and is leaning hard into AI, including an engine that cut manual effort 70 percent.

That appetite for automation rarely reaches the top of funnel, where signals sit for days and good-fit accounts go cold. Our AI SDR turns a signal into a researched, personalized touch with zero human time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, auto-logged to the CRM.

I built a personalized signal play for PureLogics off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Hamza, quick follow-up for PureLogics.

From an ops seat, the real cost is latency: how long a signal waits before someone works it, and how much rep time burns on research and CRM logging instead of conversations. Closing that gap is usually the fastest measurable lift available.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Hamza, last bit of proof for PureLogics.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PureLogics's reply rate likely compares to other services and software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Hamza, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters, and I know standing up new ops processes is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I will tailor it to PureLogics either way.
